name: set_game_volume
description: Sets the master or category audio volume preferences of the game instance at runtime.

volume.description: Target volume level from 0.0 (fully muted) to 1.0 (maximum volume).

category.description: Optional volume category to target ('master', 'game', 'music', 'ambient', 'ui'). Defaults to 'master'.

name: inspect_csharp_field
description: Queries the value of any static or nested C# field/property in the game using reflection. Example: 'Verse.Prefs.VolumeMaster' or 'RimWorld.Find.CurrentMap.Biome.defName'.

path.description: The fully qualified member path to resolve.

name: write_debugger_log
description: Writes a custom debug message into RimWorld's log system (Player.log). Useful for injecting diagnostic trace points.

message.description: The message text to write to the log.

name: get_colonists_profile
description: Get detailed information of all colonists in the colony, including their skills (shooting, melee), traits, weapon equipped, and health/injury conditions.

compact.description: If true, returns extremely compact/abbreviated details to save token costs.

name: get_stockpile_details
description: Get exact resource counts currently stored in stockpiles (e.g. food nutrition, medicine, silver, steel, components, drugs, etc.).

compact.description: If true, returns extremely compact details to save token costs by omitting zero-value keys.

name: find_items_on_map
description: Search the map for loose items (weapons, apparel, food, medicine, resources, drugs) by defName, label search term, or category. Returns their names, positions (x, z), distance from center, and item ID.

searchTerm.description: Optional: Text match search pattern in the item's label (e.g. 'Assault Rifle', 'Pills').

name: get_active_threats
description: List all active threats present on the colony map (e.g. hostiles, infestations, crashed ship parts, fire counts).

compact.description: If true, returns extremely compact details to save token costs by omitting zero-value threat keys.

name: get_colony_moods
description: Get mood status, breakdowns, and primary negative thoughts of the colony's colonists.

compact.description: If true, returns extremely compact details to save token costs by omitting list of negative thoughts.

name: get_map_environment
description: Get environmental details of the player's map, including biome, current temperature, weather, cave/overhead mountain roof cell count, and number of geothermal steam vents.

compact.description: If true, returns extremely compact details to save token costs by omitting full turrets, doors, and generators details lists (returns counts instead).

name: get_available_incidents
description: Get the list of all storyteller incidents available to be fired, including their def names, base weights, description, and modder-supplied thematic guides (narrative context guidelines).

compact.description: If true, returns extremely compact details to save token costs by omitting description and thematicGuide text.

name: possess_colonist
description: Take direct controller possession of a colonist, preventing player overrides, and directing them to perform actions (move, attack, draft, undraft, or clear). Specify release conditions like Damage, Downed, ExtremeMood, Hunger, Exhaustion, Bleeding, EnemyNearby, TargetReached, Timer.

pawnName.description: Short name of the colonist to possess (e.g. John).

commandName.description: Description of the compulsion / reason (e.g. Seeking closure, Wandering in grief).

action.description: Action to perform: move, teleport, attack, draft, undraft, clear, equip, ingest, prioritize.

targetThingId.description: Optional: Unique load ID (ThingID) of a target object (like a bed frame or steel vein) to prioritize/work on.

targetX.description: Optional: Target X map coordinate for movement or item interaction.

targetZ.description: Optional: Target Z map coordinate for movement or item interaction.

targetPawnName.description: Optional: Target pawn name to attack.

targetItemDef.description: Optional: DefName of the item to equip or ingest.

targetItemName.description: Optional: Match string in display label of the item to equip or ingest.

releaseConditions.description: Optional: List of conditions that release possession (e.g. ["Damage", "EnemyNearby", "ExtremeMood"]).

allowForbidden.description: Optional: If true, allows interacting with forbidden items or structures. Useful for mental breaks or storyteller self-harm events.

maxDurationTicks.description: Optional: Ticks before automatic timeout release (e.g. 10000. Default is 10000).

name: trigger_colonist_break
description: Trigger a dynamic mental break evaluation for a colonist under high-stress. Strips RimWorld context and uses a safe geometric abstraction solver to resolve conflicts.

pawnName.description: The name of the colonist experiencing the break.

planFilePath.description: The absolute file path of the JSON break plan generated by the Storyteller.

name: control_turret
description: Control a map turret's power state, targeting overrides, or self-destruct detonation. Turrets must be sabotaged first by a possessed pawn, or directly under storytelling control.

turretId.description: The unique load ID of the target turret (obtained via get_map_environment).

action.description: Action to perform: shutdown, poweron, fire_at_target, detonate, sabotage.

targetPawnName.description: Optional: Target colonist name for fire_at_target.

name: fire_weapon_at_cell
description: Simulate a weapon blast or gunshot from a source pawn targeting a specific map coordinate cell. Spawns visual bullet impacts and deals damage or explosion effects.

pawnName.description: The name of the pawn firing the weapon.

damageType.description: Optional: Damage type to deal. Options: 'bomb', 'bullet', 'bullet_high_damage'. Default: 'bullet'.

name: damage_self_with_equipped
description: Force a pawn to inflict damage on themselves (suicide) using their currently equipped weapon. Can target a specific body part (e.g. Head, Heart) with a damage multiplier.

targetBodyPart.description: The Def name of the target body part (e.g. Head, Heart, Brain).

damageMultiplier.description: Optional: Damage multiplier to ensure lethality (usually 2.0 to 5.0).

name: attempt_remote_hack
description: Attempt to remotely breach and hack a map electronic object (turret, power generator, or door). Requires a powered Comms Console and a nearby Hacker Base within 8 world map tiles. Hacked turrets target friendlies for 5m. Hacked generators shut down for 1h. Hacked doors lock shut for 1h. Success starts a 4h firewall reboot cooldown.

targetId.description: The unique load ID of the target object (turret, generator, or door).

hackerSkill.description: Optional: Hacker power level (1 to 100, defaults to 50).

name: spawn_hacker_base
description: Spawn a hostile Hacker Base outpost on the world map within 8 tiles of the colony to establish a network hacking broadcast uplink.

name: search_map_entities
description: Search and list entities (pawns, animals, items, buildings, plants) currently on the map. Can filter to only show things visible on the player's screen.

query.description: Optional search query to filter by name, label, or definition (e.g. 'cow', 'centipede', 'silver').

includeTypes.description: Comma-separated types to include: 'pawns', 'animals', 'colonists', 'enemies', 'items', 'buildings', 'plants'. Defaults to 'all'.

onlyVisibleOnScreen.description: If true, only returns entities within the player's current screen camera view.

name: search_game_definitions
description: Queries the dynamically compiled list of game object definitions (ThingDefs, HediffDefs, TraitDefs, etc.) to map common human terms to exact C# DefNames.

query.description: The keyword or concept to search for (e.g. 'shotgun', 'infection', 'bipolar', 'flu').

defType.description: Optional: Filter search to a specific Def category ('ThingDef', 'HediffDef', 'TraitDef', 'IncidentDef', 'NeedDef', 'ThoughtDef', 'MentalStateDef').

name: get_colonist_psychology_profile
description: Retrieves traits, sanity breaks predictions, weighted memories, burdens, social network relationship stats (trust/familiarity), and therapy sessions history for a colonist.

name: get_recent_social_interactions
description: Retrieves a chronological list of recent social chatter logs (insults, chit-chat, deep talks) on the map.

pawnName.description: Optional: Filter social interactions involving a specific colonist name

name: trigger_mood_booster
description: Applies a balanced temporary thought buff or debuff to a colonist. Limit once per 4 hours.

effectType.description: The direction of the mood effect

reason.description: Brief narrative reason for this mood shift

name: trigger_relationship_shift
description: Applies a balanced opinion shift between two colonists via social thought memories. Max once per 6 hours.

reason.description: Brief narrative reason for the shift

name: inspire_colonist
description: Attempts to trigger a vanilla inspiration on a happy colonist. Cooldown is once per day across the colony.

pawnName.description: Name of the colonist to inspire

name: get_royal_demands
description: Retrieves the noble titles, demands, active decrees, and privileges of a noble colonist (Royalty DLC).

name: get_faith_precepts
description: Retrieves the active ideoligion, role, social precepts, and relics of a colonist (Ideology DLC).

name: apply_conversion_attempt
description: Executes a vanilla faith conversion check based on opinion, social skills, and certainty (Ideology DLC).

recipientName.description: Name of the colonist being converted

name: get_xenotype_identity
description: Retrieves the genes list, xenotype classification, and age group of a colonist (Biotech DLC).

name: get_mechanitor_status
description: Retrieves the bandwidth, complexity, and active controlled mechanoids list for a Mechanitor (Biotech DLC).

name: get_void_melancholy
description: Retrieves monolith study levels, void obsession progress, and void mental states of a colonist (Anomaly DLC).

name: attempt_mental_soothe
description: Tries to calm a panic or light void mental break state via conversation (Anomaly DLC).

initiatorName.description: Name of the speaker trying to soothe

name: get_orbital_hazards
description: Retrieves space biome coordinates, ship systems damage, and active orbital travel hazards (SOS2/Odyssey).
